data.description:
## Incident Overview

S1 (story 908b-11e4-dd14-4ea3 in epic d076-d35e-55db-4843) renamed the file from sprint-story-review.yml to per-branch-review.yml, but the top-level name: field inside the workflow still reads "Sprint Story Review". This causes the GitHub Actions UI to display "Sprint Story Review" for runs of the new file.

Impact is purely cosmetic — GitHub Branch Protection required-check matching uses individual JOB names (e.g., "Per-Story LLM Review", "Actionlint", "ShellCheck"), not the workflow-level name, so the dso.review.check_name=Sprint Story Review config still maps correctly to the per-story-review job.

## Fix
Single-line edit: change line 1 of .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml from "name: Sprint Story Review" to "name: Per-branch Review".

## Notes
Surfaced during workflow scenario validation while remediating bugs 85f3-8301-c1b0-479d and 660e-4317-620d-44bb.
data.title: [per-branch-review.yml]: Top-level workflow name -> Still reads 'Sprint Story Review' after S1 rename
